info.title: TikTok
info.description: Read-only access to TikTok API for Business campaigns, ad groups, ads and their lifetime insights. Pass the long-term access token to every action.

post.description: One-time setup: exchanges the authorization code from the advertiser authorization page for a long-term access token, and lists the advertiser IDs that were authorized. Store both in the environment variables.

auth_code.description: auth_code from the redirect URL; valid for 1 hour, single use.

get.description: Lists the advertisers (ad accounts) the access token is authorized for.

parameters.name: Access-Token
parameters.description: TikTok long-term access token (environment variable TikTok Ads Access Token).

parameters.name: app_id
parameters.description: TikTok developer app ID.

parameters.name: secret
parameters.description: TikTok developer app secret.

get.description: Name, currency, time zone and status of an advertiser (ad account).

parameters.name: Access-Token
parameters.description: TikTok long-term access token (environment variable TikTok Ads Access Token).

parameters.name: advertiser_id
parameters.description: TikTok advertiser (ad account) ID.

get.description: Lists all campaigns of an advertiser with every field TikTok returns, including deleted ones.

parameters.name: Access-Token
parameters.description: TikTok long-term access token (environment variable TikTok Ads Access Token).

parameters.name: advertiser_id
parameters.description: TikTok advertiser (ad account) ID.

parameters.name: campaign_id
parameters.description: Only return items of this campaign.

parameters.name: include_deleted
parameters.description: Also return deleted items (TikTok leaves them out by default).

parameters.name: max_rows
parameters.description: Stop after this many rows. Omit to return everything.

get.description: Lists ad groups (all of the advertiser, or of one campaign) with every field TikTok returns, including deleted ones.
